Game Overview

Utka Clash is a first-person shooter game built around fight for survival in the eerie arena of Utka Clash, where mannequins come to life as relentless foes. Outsmart them with agility and tactical prowess, while the diverse environment offers strategic opportunities. Can you withstand the onslaught and emerge victorious, armed only with instinct and the weapons you find?
